items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury sustained in Wednesday practice; limited Wed, DNP Thu/Fri. Grade 1 not believed serious long-term but out for Week 2 vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring; history of multi-week absences in past.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in HOU offense already thin at WR.

items.text: Ravens list WR Zay Flowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints after missing practices with hamstring; second straight DNP.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated; limited practice history this week.
items.implication: High risk of inactive; hierarchy shifts if out.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for Bateman/Walker et al.

items.text: Raiders list TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee injury, per HC.
items.why: Knee; HC confirmation.
items.implication: Likely limited or out; Mayer/others benefit.

items.text: Chargers list WR Ladd McConkey questionable for Sunday vs Raiders due to rib injury; did practice Friday.
items.why: Rib injury; positive practice participation Friday.
items.implication: Game-time lean possible; monitor further.

items.text: Bengals list QB Joe Burrow questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury; Burrow said he would play, full practice Fri after limited earlier.
items.why: Back; self-reported play intent + FP Fri.
items.implication: Expected to play but monitor; CIN pass game hinges.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go'; unclear exact share vs Rhamondre Stevenson but timing ideal—Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc pre-bye).
items.why: Self-reported readiness + team need post-Brown IR + matchup slate.
items.implication: Potential committee expansion or lead if Stevenson limited; stash/start consideration.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring, missed practices) can't go, Ravens WR order: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane already IR wrist.
items.why: Practice absences + prior IR on Lane create clear hierarchy.
items.implication: Bateman becomes primary if Flowers inactive.
items.opportunity: Snap/route elevation for remaining BAL WRs.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers: McConkey injury = Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; Brown IR=Doubs/Douglas; Kamara=Miller; Murray=Wentz. Snaps/pace live; OL/DL mismatches (e.g. SEA DL > ARI OL).
items.why: Precise injury-driven beneficiaries + usage data.
items.implication: Priority adds for depth/spot starts.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in first game under Kubiak (2nd only to Bijan); overreaction to injury scare likely.
items.why: Near-max utilization confirms workhorse role.
items.implication: Strong start/sit lock with volume floor.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share sharing backfield with Gainwell; +8 routes, both RB RZ touches.
items.why: Passing-game/RZ dominance over Gainwell.
items.implication: Three-down role expanding; start confidently.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in KC debut; 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q; RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy. Smash vs IND.
items.why: Elite early usage/target share + matchup vs soft IND run D.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 with massive ceiling.

items.text: Harold Fannin HATE: 14% tgt share lowest since W5 last yr, low yards; more competition + Watson QB. Also HATE Etienne/MHJ/BTJ per Love/Hate.
items.why: Depressed share/competition for Fannin; scheme/usage concerns others.
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of better options.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE (37% tgt share w/ Wentz, strong hist); DeVonta Smith LOVE bounceback; Dak Prescott LOVE (home smash vs WAS, high total). Mike Evans also LOVE.
items.why: Usage/matchup/history for Jefferson/Smith; Dak home/total; Evans continuity.
items.implication: Priority starts at WR/QB.
